training_set_three_level_classification.change: authorized, audited employment/onboarding classification; client timestamps and created_at are not classification authority

training_confirm_legacy_three_level.change: records immutable evidence source/date/reference, reviewer and reviewed_at before legacy_verified

training_assign_three_level_program.change: compatibility wrapper; client plan arguments are ignored and the existing S3-B resolver/snapshot selects the frozen scheme, packages and stage types

training_ensure_three_level_requirement.change: production entrypoint that generates or reuses one immutable requirement snapshot and materializes D11 records from its required stage items

training_sync_three_level_tasks.change: compatibility no-op for employee three-level generation; project admission only references the employee foundation status

training_three_level_exam_gate.binding: a published comprehensive exam plan requires exactly one explicit training_admissions.exam_assignment_id binding

training_start_admission.change: creates project admission without generating another employee three-level program

foundation_rules.formal_internal: one auditable three-level foundation per employment relation; rehire creates a new relation
foundation_rules.permanence: completed or verified foundation does not expire by project, entity, position or calendar year change
foundation_rules.legacy: unverified existing employees fail closed to evidence review or one supplement; no migration fabricates completion

third_level.basic_project: source_project_id is null and responsible entity is explicit; does not represent project-entry training
third_level.actual_project: source_project_id is required and remains historical evidence after later project changes

requirement_authority.new_or_not_started: latest effective configuration is resolved once and frozen in requirement snapshot
requirement_authority.already_started: on-demand legacy_d11_compatibility snapshot freezes existing truthful plan/version facts
requirement_authority.already_completed: completed, legacy_verified and legacy_supplement_completed remain satisfied without forced snapshot backfill
requirement_authority.rehire: a new employment relation receives its own snapshot and never reuses the previous relation snapshot
requirement_authority.project_induction: independent and never treated as a fourth three-level stage

future_special_training.interface: existing package item level=special remains supported
